faq.q: How far is Puerto Banús from the Ironman Marbella finish line?
faq.a: Puerto Banús is roughly 5 km (3 miles) from the Ironman finish area, a 10-15 minute drive. Most charter boats are moored at the main dock, making it easy to walk aboard after the race.

faq.q: What boats are best for post-race recovery?
faq.a: The Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) offers ample shaded deck space and a comfortable saloon. For smaller groups, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) provides a cosy setting with sun pads and a swim platform.

Yes. Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No extra charges – just bring your swimsuit.

faq.q: Can we bring our own recovery food or supplements?
faq.a: Absolutely. You are welcome to bring your own snacks, protein shakes, or recovery meals. The boat has a small fridge and cooler. We provide light snacks, but you can supplement as needed.

faq.q: What is the minimum charter duration for recovery trips?
faq.a: Most boats offer 2-hour, 4-hour, and 8-hour charters. For a quick post-race unwind, a 2-hour trip (€749 on Tier A boats) is ideal. For a full day of relaxation, an 8-hour charter gives you time to cruise to Cala del Faro or Estepona.

faq.q: Is there a jet ski available for post-race fun?
faq.a: Yes, the Mangusta 80 (both white and grey variants) includes a free jet ski with a minimum 4-hour charter (€4,719). It’s a great way to enjoy the water without extra cost.

faq.q: What if the weather is bad on race day?

data.body_html:
Crossing the finish line of Ironman Marbella 2045 is a monumental achievement. After months of training, your body deserves more than a protein shake and a cold shower. A post-race recovery yacht charter from Puerto Banús offers the ultimate way to soothe sore muscles, celebrate with teammates, and soak up the Costa del Sol sun. With our fleet of 17 luxury boats, all departing from Puerto Banús, you can step straight from the race into a private floating sanctuary. Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, light snacks, and insurance – so you can focus entirely on recovery.

Whether you want a quiet 2-hour cruise along the Golden Mile or a full-day escape to Cala del Faro, our all-inclusive packages start at €749. Read on to find the perfect boat for your Ironman recovery day.

Why Choose a Yacht Charter for Ironman Recovery?

Post-race recovery is about rest, hydration, and gentle movement. A yacht charter delivers all three. You can float on calm Mediterranean waters, rehydrate with complimentary water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, or cava, and enjoy light snacks while lying on sun pads. The gentle rocking of the boat aids muscle relaxation, and the sea breeze reduces inflammation. Unlike a crowded beach or a noisy restaurant, a private yacht gives you a peaceful environment to reflect on your 226 km journey. Plus, you can swim in secluded coves like Cala Cortés or Cabopino – a low-impact way to keep blood flowing without stressing joints.

Our Fleet: Best Boats for Post-Race Relaxation

Our fleet ranges from 6.4 m speedboats to 29 m superyachts. For recovery, larger boats with shaded flybridges and spacious saloons are ideal. Here are the top picks for Ironman athletes:

  • Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6 m, 12 pax) – Four cabins, a large flybridge with sun loungers, and a saloon with air conditioning. Perfect for a group of athletes or family supporters. Browse all Marbella yacht charters for full fleet details.
  • Astondoa 40 (12.5 m, 9 pax) – An affordable option for smaller groups. Includes a swim platform and plenty of sunbathing space. Price: €749 for 2 hours.
  • Mangusta 80 (24 m, 12 pax) – A sleek open yacht with a free jet ski. Minimum 4-hour charter at €4,719. Ideal for those who want a mix of relaxation and water fun.
  • Ferretti 94 (29 m, 12 pax) – The ultimate luxury. Onboard jacuzzi, multiple lounges, and a professional crew. Pricing on request via WhatsApp.

All boats depart from Puerto Banús, a 10-minute drive from the Ironman finish line. Arrive directly at the dock and step aboard.

Suggested Recovery Itineraries

Customise your day based on how you feel. Here are three itineraries:

2 hoursPuerto Banús → Marbella Marina → returnCoastal views, swim stop, drinks and snacks€749 (Astondoa 40)
4 hoursPuerto Banús → Cala del Faro → CabopinoSecluded cove, snorkelling, jet ski (Mangusta 80)€4,719 (Mangusta 80)
8 hoursPuerto Banús → Estepona → SotograndeLunch at a beach club, swimming, full relaxation€2,299 (Astondoa 40)

For larger groups, consider the Azimut 58 Flybridge for an 8-hour trip. Check availability for Ironman dates.

What’s Included in Your Charter

No hidden costs. Every booking includes:

  • Licensed skipper (English and Spanish speaking)
  • Fuel for the entire charter
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (crisps, nuts, olives)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21% tax)

You are welcome to bring your own recovery food, supplements, or personal items. The boat has a fridge and cooler.

How to Book Your Ironman Recovery Yacht Charter

Booking is simple. For Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39), reserve directly on our website with a deposit. For all other yachts, message us on WhatsApp for real-time availability and pricing. We recommend booking at least 2 weeks in advance for Ironman weekend, as demand is high. Contact us today to secure your post-race celebration.

Frequently asked questions

How far is Puerto Banús from the Ironman Marbella finish line?

Puerto Banús is roughly 5 km (3 miles) from the Ironman finish area, a 10-15 minute drive. Most charter boats are moored at the main dock, making it easy to walk aboard after the race.

What boats are best for post-race recovery?

The Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) offers ample shaded deck space and a comfortable saloon. For smaller groups, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) provides a cosy setting with sun pads and a swim platform.

Are the charter prices all-inclusive?

Yes. Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No extra charges – just bring your swimsuit.

Can we bring our own recovery food or supplements?

Absolutely. You are welcome to bring your own snacks, protein shakes, or recovery meals. The boat has a small fridge and cooler. We provide light snacks, but you can supplement as needed.

What is the minimum charter duration for recovery trips?

Most boats offer 2-hour, 4-hour, and 8-hour charters. For a quick post-race unwind, a 2-hour trip (€749 on Tier A boats) is ideal. For a full day of relaxation, an 8-hour charter gives you time to cruise to Cala del Faro or Estepona.

Is there a jet ski available for post-race fun?

Yes, the Mangusta 80 (both white and grey variants) includes a free jet ski with a minimum 4-hour charter (€4,719). It’s a great way to enjoy the water without extra cost.

What if the weather is bad on race day?

Marbella enjoys 320 sunny days a year, but if conditions are unsafe, we will reschedule or offer a full refund. The sheltered Marbella coastline is usually calm, even in spring.

How do I book a recovery yacht charter for Ironman Marbella 2045?

Book directly through our website or via WhatsApp. For Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) you can reserve online with a deposit. For larger yachts, contact us for availability and pricing.
